_about: Armature has no eval file format (docs.armature.tech/evaluation/eval-cases: cases are created in the dashboard). This file is the hand-conversion of evals/demo-workflow.json: one dashboard eval case per entry, all placed in the suite below. Paste prompt and criteria verbatim; mark criteria 'required' unless noted. Targets: one Claude model in Claude Code (Free plan allows 1 target per case).

mcpServer.name: steward
mcpServer.note: Register in Armature → MCP Setup → Add MCP server with the Manufact URL (not a laptop URL). If STEWARD_MCP_TOKEN is set, add it as a Bearer credential there.

cases.prompt: At the Harbor Works site, find out whether pump P-101 has a valid commissioning certificate on record. Do not spend any budget. Report the status, how old the record is, and the attestation id you were given.
criteria: The agent calls the resolve tool with siteId 'harbor', assetTag 'P-101' and attribute 'commissioning_certificate' (not list_assets guesses or free text).
The agent reports status 'known' and quotes the attestationId returned by the tool.
The agent does not call attest, patrol or escalate, and does not pass a budget greater than 0.
The agent states the age of the record from observedAt or ageSeconds rather than inventing a date.

cases.prompt: You are clearing Harbor Works for restart. You need the current pressure reading on pump P-101 (attribute pressure_bar). If it is not known, spend up to 2 dollars of budget to have a technician read it, then stop and tell me the work item reference. Do not make up a value.
criteria: The agent first resolves P-101 pressure_bar and observes status 'unknown' (no fact exists for it).
The agent calls resolve again (or initially) with budget greater than 0 and at most 2, and receives a workItemId and a reference matching ^HW-P101-PRESSURE_BAR-\d{4}$.
The agent does not state a numeric pressure value anywhere in its answer.
The agent does not poll resolve or get_receipt more than three times while waiting; it reports that it is waiting and stops.

criteria.text: The agent mentions that a callback or get_changes can be used to learn when the reading arrives.

cases.prompt: A technician has replied to work item reference HW-P101-PRESSURE_BAR-0001 at Harbor Works with a reading of 2.4 bar, but the photo's tag plate reads P-102. Submit this observation with attest (source kind 'human', statedTag 'P-102') and tell me exactly why Steward accepted or rejected it and what the technician should do next.
criteria: The agent calls attest with siteId 'harbor', assetTag 'P-101', attribute 'pressure_bar', value 2.4 and statedTag 'P-102'.
The agent reports verdict 'rejected' and quotes the identity check reason, which names P-102, P-101 and a distance/direction between them.
The agent does not record or claim a fact or attestation id for this submission.
The agent tells the technician to photograph the gauge on P-101 with its own tag plate visible, using the direction given in the reason.

cases.prompt: The technician has now sent a correct photo for HW-P101-PRESSURE_BAR-0001: tag plate P-101, gauge reading 2.4 bar, taken just now. Submit it with attest (source kind 'human', statedTag 'P-101') and give me the attestation id and the resulting fact.
criteria: The agent calls attest with statedTag 'P-101', value 2.4 and an observedAt within the last few minutes (or omits observedAt).
The agent reports verdict 'accepted' with all six checks (scope, identity, geometry, plausibility, time, integrity) passed and quotes the attestationId.
The agent then calls get_receipt or get_changes and reports the work item state as 'resolved'.
The agent does not claim a payment was made unless the receipt shows cost greater than 0.

cases.prompt: Another agent gave you attestation id <paste the id from the previous case> for P-101 pressure at Harbor Works. Verify it without redoing any work and tell me whether it is valid, what it attests, and who signed it.
criteria: The agent calls the check tool with the attestation id and no other write tools.
The agent reports valid: true and the attested asset tag, attribute, value and observedAt from the record.
The agent names the verifier version (steward-verify/1) and that the signature is Ed25519 with a server public key, as returned by the tool.
The agent does not call resolve with a budget or attest during this task.
